newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares off highs but may continue climb.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares off highs but may continue climb.

text.p: 1720 GMT - Shares ended slightly below earlier peaks -- but the close was still a record -- after a session hampered by technical problems. Traders say the widely expected correction may be delayed a little longer -- providing there is no sharp sell-off in New York -- as buying pressure from domestic funds remains strong.
*By 1733 GMT the PSI20 index, which had not finished updating following earlier technical hitches, stood at 8,079.23 points, up 1.05 percent but below its day high of 8,126.52.
*PSI July futures were up 125 points at 8,092.
*EDP was down 9 escudos at 3,305 on turnover of 651,870.
*Portucel was up 41 escudos at 1,479 with 510,030 shares traded.
*Traders said domestic investment funds were responsible for the good liquidity of over 16 billion escudos as they sought to place cash being switched out of low-yielding fixed-term deposits.
*"It was a buyers market at the close. I think that tomorrow the uptrend will be continued but we have to see what happens abroad and to the dollar," said one trader.
